title: Community Health Worker (CHW) EPDS Screening
subtitle: Validated 10-question Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale assessment tool for frontline maternal triage.
instructions: Ask the mother to describe how she has felt in the past 7 days. Select the option that best reflects her answer.

low.label: Low Risk (0-9 points)
low.desc: Mother demonstrates positive maternal adaptation with normal postpartum adjustment fatigue.
low.advice: Offer words of affirmation. Encourage nutritious hydration, rest when baby rests, and routine community health check-ins.

elevated.label: Elevated Emotional Strain (10-12 points)
elevated.desc: Notable signs of emotional exhaustion, anxiety, insomnia, or unnecessary guilt.
elevated.advice: Schedule a supportive home visit within 48 hours. Guide mother through breathing exercises and connect with peer maternal support groups.

crisis.label: High Risk / Crisis (13+ points or Item 10 > 0)
crisis.desc: Severe emotional distress or presence of suicidal / self-harm ideation.
crisis.advice: Urgent clinical escalation required. Do not leave the mother alone. Connect immediately with 1199 emergency or medical officer.
